proposal.summary: A local command-injection / path-traversal vulnerability in the inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service of Druva inSync Windows Client 6.6.3 allows an unprivileged local user to execute arbitrary commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.
proposal.cwe_quote: Command injection in inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service

AV.quote: Exploit run against local RPC service on 127.0.0.1 and uses local socket to connect

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproduction on a maintained test system and capture a minimal proof-of-concept showing command execution and resulting SYSTEM context; notify vendor and prepare coordinated disclosure with suggested mitigation (update service to validate paths robustly and remove directory-traversal bypass).

evidence_quotes.quote: The path validation has been only implemented through a 'strncmp' function which can be bypassed by appending a directory traversal escape sequence at the end of the valid path.
